ITEM.PTXT: By selecting the "Audio" button on the start screen while using the audio, the screen changes to the audio mode screen, where the operating status and operation of music sources (AM/FM radio, CD, etc.) and audio adjustments such as sound quality and volume balance can be performed.
Music sources have been enhanced by supporting WMA (Windows Media Audio)/MP3 (MPEG1 Audio Layer3) and adopting a sound library that allows music CDs to be recorded on the built-in HDD.

Up to 2000 songs from music CDs can be recorded onto the built-in HDD. Recorded music is managed in 4 play modes (artist, recording date, genre, my best), and the desired music can be easily searched for and played from these.
Depending on the recording time, recording quality, free space on the HDD, etc., it may not be possible to record 2000 songs.
